title: 耐克跑步逆势增长：大中华区营收却骤降26%，修复超过12个月够吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So Nike started to slow down before Elliott Hill had come into the equation that said, since he's come on board, what he has fixed is North America and performance. So we do give him credit
segments.zh: 所以耐克在埃利奥特·希尔加入之前就开始放缓了，但自从他上任以来，他修复了北美和性能品类。我们对此给予肯定。

segments.en: for that. That though there's so much more to fix sports where roughly 50% of Nike's business is still down. Jordan is down and China is plunging as we speak. It was down 26% in the latest quarter
segments.zh: 不过还有太多要修复的，运动品类约占耐克业务的一半，仍然下滑。乔丹品牌也在下滑，而中国市场正在大幅下滑。最新季度下降了26%。

segments.en: and things will probably get worse before they get better. So the fix isn't over. It's going to take more than 12 months in our view and we don't know what steps they're going to take exactly

segments.en: and what will work from here. So waiting to hear more at the analyst meeting in November, but there's a lot of things that Nike still needs to fix to get this ship on board again.

segments.en: So there's a reporting on the Bloomberg that, you know, probably some investors are starting to get a little impatient with this management team here.
segments.zh: 所以彭博社有报道称，一些市场参与者可能开始对这支管理团队有点不耐烦了。
